title: Central Repo Config
description: Configuration file for a monorepo using central, optionally read from .central/repo-config.json at the root of the repository.

$schema.description: The JSON schema for this configuration file

rootRepoName.description: The name of the monorepo itself, as shown e.g. in `central todo`'s table, and used to resolve `central` as a "which repos" selector on the command line.
